ResourceHeader.ResourceName: GOES-14 SEM/XRS Science Level 2 2-second X-ray Irradiance

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial metadata creation and publication. SY

ResourceHeader.Description: GOES-14 Solar X-ray Sensor (SEM/XRS) science-quality Level 2 2-second solar X-ray irradiance (irrad) product, provided as archived NetCDF files. XRS-A covers 0.05-0.4 nm and XRS-B covers 0.1-0.8 nm. The product provides XRS-A and XRS-B irradiance, raw detector counts, science-quality flags, and original SWPC flags for both channels. Science-quality irradiances are retrospectively reprocessed using updated calibration and are not reduced by the historical operational scaling factors of 0.85 (XRS-A) and 0.70 (XRS-B). Consult the NOAA GOES 8-15 XRS Science-Quality Data ReadMe for processing methods and caveats.

NumericalData.ProviderResourceName: NOAA Space Environment Monitor (SEM) Science-Quality Solar X-Ray Sensor (XRS) Data from GOES 1-15
NumericalData.Caveats: GOES-8 through GOES-15 XRS science-quality irradiances may be affected by energetic electron contamination. Unlike GOES-R XRS Science Level 2 1-minute irradiance products, these data have not been corrected for electron contamination.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A channel irradiance
Parameter.Description: Science-quality solar X-ray irradiance in the XRS-A (0.05-0.4 nm) channel at PT2S nominal cadence. The legacy operational scaling factor is not applied; energetic electron contamination is not corrected.
Parameter.Caveats: A systematic calibration discrepancy remains between GOES-8 through GOES-15 XRS-A (short channel) irradiances and GOES-R XRS-A irradiances. The GOES-16/GOES-15 XRS-A ratio is approximately 1.34; this comparison is not a universal per-satellite correction factor. Evidence suggests that GOES-R calibration is more accurate.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B channel irradiance
Parameter.Description: Science-quality solar X-ray irradiance in the XRS-B (0.1-0.8 nm) channel at PT2S nominal cadence. The legacy operational scaling factor is not applied; energetic electron contamination is not corrected.

Parameter.Name: Flags for Science-Quality XRS-A
Parameter.Description: Quality bit mask for XRS-A high-cadence irradiance: 0=good_data; 1=calibration; 2=off_pointed; 4=eclipsed_by_earth; 8=eclipsed_by_moon; 16=eclipsed_by_unknown; 32=temperature_recovery; 64=spike; 128=unknown_bad_data; consult NetCDF for remaining flags. Consult NetCDF flag_masks and flag_meanings for complete definitions.
Parameter.Caveats: Missing measurements are represented by fill values, but the corresponding bad-data quality flags are not always set. Users should check fill values as well as quality flags when screening the data.

Parameter.Name: Flags for Science-Quality XRS-B
Parameter.Description: Quality bit mask for XRS-B high-cadence irradiance: 0=good_data; 1=calibration; 2=off_pointed; 4=eclipsed_by_earth; 8=eclipsed_by_moon; 16=eclipsed_by_unknown; 32=temperature_recovery; 64=spike; 128=unknown_bad_data; consult NetCDF for remaining flags. Consult NetCDF flag_masks and flag_meanings for complete definitions.
Parameter.Caveats: Missing measurements are represented by fill values, but the corresponding bad-data quality flags are not always set. Users should check fill values as well as quality flags when screening the data.

Parameter.Name: Flags for SWPC Operational XRS-A
Parameter.Description: Original NOAA SWPC operational status flags associated with the XRS-A counts and irradiance, retained for historical reference. These flags are distinct from the science-quality a_flags. Flag bit definitions are provided in the flag_masks and flag_meanings attributes of the a_swpc_flags variable in the NetCDF files.

Parameter.Name: Flags for SWPC Operational XRS-B
Parameter.Description: Original NOAA SWPC operational status flags associated with the XRS-B counts and irradiance, retained for historical reference. These flags are distinct from the science-quality b_flags. Flag bit definitions are provided in the flag_masks and flag_meanings attributes of the b_swpc_flags variable in the NetCDF files.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A channel counts
Parameter.Description: Raw XRS-A detector counts associated with the high-cadence irradiance measurement.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B channel counts
Parameter.Description: Raw XRS-B detector counts associated with the high-cadence irradiance measurement.

Parameter.Name: Record start time
Parameter.Description: Start time of each 2-second irradiance record, expressed as seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00.0 UTC; consult the source NetCDF for time encoding and leap-second handling.
